label: Partial and Multiple Correlation — unseen mastery test

items.stem: Which coefficient measures the linear association between X1 and X2 without controlling another variable?
items.explanation: Simple correlation is the unadjusted pairwise linear association.

options: Correlation between residuals after linear control
items.explanation: Regress both target variables on the control variable and correlate their residuals.

items.explanation: Multiple R is the non-negative square root of the coefficient of determination.

items.stem: Which statements about partial correlation are correct?
items.explanation: A, B and C are true. D is false because a zero partial correlation does not generally prove independence.
statements: It can be calculated as a correlation between residuals.
A zero value always proves conditional independence.

A.why: Control variables are removed linearly from both target variables.

B.why: Residual correlation is the regression interpretation.

C.why: Partial correlation is signed and lies between −1 and 1.

D.why: Zero partial correlation means no remaining linear association, not general independence.

items.stem: Which statements about multiple correlation are correct?
items.explanation: A, B and C are true; D is false because R is not signed.
statements: R² is the coefficient of determination for the predictor set.
R is the non-negative square root of R².

A.why: R² is the proportion of response variation explained by the fitted linear model.

B.why: The conventional multiple correlation coefficient is non-negative.

C.why: The one-predictor model gives the square of the simple correlation.

D.why: Multiple R is defined as non-negative.

items.stem: Which statements correctly distinguish partial and multiple correlation?
items.explanation: A, B and C are correct. D is false because the two statistics answer different questions.
statements: Multiple correlation combines a response with a predictor set.
A partial coefficient may be negative.
Partial and multiple correlation are interchangeable names.

A.why: Partial correlation measures the remaining association after control.

B.why: Multiple correlation measures association with the predictor set.
